Lie on every mattress, sit on every bed and feel every fabric before you buy. Then let our own delivery team bring it home.

settings.heading: Questions, answered
settings.text: Quick answers about delivery, paying and sizes. More in our help pages.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: Most beds and mattresses are delivered within 5 to 7 working days. Our two-person team carries everything to the room of your choice and takes the packaging away.

settings.question: Can I pay in instalments?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose Klarna at checkout to split the cost into smaller payments. Klarna checks your eligibility and sets its own terms.

settings.question: Which size should I choose?
settings.answer: Single 90 x 190 cm, double 135 x 190 cm, king 150 x 200 cm, super king 180 x 200 cm. Every product page lists the exact outside measurements.

settings.question: Do headboards fit any bed?
settings.answer: Bolt-on headboards fit most divans and bed frames. Floor-standing and wall-mounted headboards fit every bed.
